name: command
title: Command menu
description: ⌘K command menu: digit cells run by index, grouped results, empty state.
whenToUse: Use it as a command palette: run commands by name with the keyboard. For commands on a trigger use Menu; for choosing a value in a form use Combobox.

parts.name: Command
parts.description: cmdk's root: the menu's filter and keyboard. ⌥1–⌥9 run the visible result with that number.

parts.name: CommandDialog
parts.description: The command menu in Dialog's frame: Base UI's Dialog root and DialogPopup around Command.

props.name: children
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: className
props.description: Class for the dialog's frame (Dialog's DialogPopup).

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => boolean | void | HTMLElement | null)
props.description: Return false when a command hands focus to another surface (e.g. opens a dialog).

parts.name: CommandEmpty
parts.description: Shown while nothing matches: a zero count beside what was searched for, and an optional hint.

props.name: children
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: query
props.description: The search, quoted in the message.

parts.name: CommandFooter
parts.description: The menu's foot: hints and keys on the bottom keyline, in the meta voice.

parts.name: CommandGroup
parts.description: Results under one heading (with an optional code). A group after a group is divided by a seam.

parts.name: CommandInput
parts.description: The query row: a search glyph cell, the input, and an esc cell, on the frame's region keyline. `className` goes to the input.

parts.name: CommandItem
parts.description: One result: its digit cell (the counter; · after the ninth), the label, and its meta and shortcut. The cursor is the inverse row; running it floods the row yellow (the flood owns the fill while it is on).

props.name: meta
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: shortcut
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

parts.name: CommandList
parts.description: The results. They scroll natively (cmdk scrolls the active row into view), in the Scroll Area's tones, and number their rows with the kl-cmd counter. Rows are separated by soft rules.

parts.name: CommandSeparator
parts.description: A seam between results. Drawn only: a listbox may hold options and groups, not a separator, so it is hidden from assistive technology (cmdk fixes its role).
